title: Agent OS Installed Extensions
description: Record kept at ~/.agent-os/installed-extensions.json of what the extension installer installed. Used for idempotence, updates, and to undo only what the installer added.

extensions.description: Installed catalog entries, keyed by catalog id.

pin.description: Commit or version that was installed.

wrapper_version.description: Version of the wrapper template that was written, if any.

installed_at.description: When the entry was installed or last updated.

repos.description: Repository paths where per_repo steps ran.

items.description: Absolute path with forward slashes (C:/Users/... on Windows).

skipped_steps.description: Optional step ids the user left out.

recorded_steps.description: Install steps with record_output whose output matched, keyed by step id. Uninstall steps with only_recorded_by run only for these.

additionalProperties.description: Repository paths where the step changed something; an empty array for a once step that matched.

items.description: Absolute repository path with forward slashes (C:/Users/... on Windows).

assignments_added.description: Skills the installer added to ~/.agent-os/defaults.json, per agent. Uninstall removes only these.

additionalProperties.description: Skills added for one agent, keyed by agent name.

errors.description: Failed steps from the last run.
